About the Role McKesson is seeking a Senior Product Manager, Finance Systems & ERP Transformation to help modernize and optimize Finance technology capabilities across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Financial Close, Reporting, and related Finance processes. Manage and prioritize the Finance Systems product backlog, including epics, features, acceptance criteria, release readiness, and stakeholder communication. Partner with Finance leaders to evaluate, optimize, and standardize processes across GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Financial Reporting, Budgeting, Forecasting, and Close. Lead requirements gathering, process mapping, gap analysis, solution design, and business case development for Finance systems initiatives. Support ERP transformation readiness, including SAP S/4HANA planning, process alignment, UAT, change management, adoption, and business readiness. Collaborate with engineering, data, analytics, integration, vendor, and platform teams to deliver scalable Finance reporting, data quality, and automation improvements. Support change control, release governance, SOX-aware requirements, auditability, and operational readiness for Finance system enhancements. Basic Requirements 7+ years of experience in Finance Systems, Business Analysis, Product Management, ERP implementations, Finance transformation, or related roles. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Experience with Finance processes such as General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Financial Reporting, Budgeting, Forecasting, or Financial Close. Experience gathering, documenting, and managing business requirements, process flows, functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Experience managing or contributing to product backlogs, roadmap priorities, sprint planning, backlog refinement, UAT, and release readiness. Experience working with ERP platforms such as PeopleSoft Financials, SAP S/4HANA, or comparable enterprise Finance systems. Experience analyzing current-state processes, designing future-state solutions, and driving measurable process improvement. Experience partnering with business stakeholders, technology teams, vendors, and implementation partners to deliver Finance systems enhancements. Preferred Skills/Experience Experience supporting large-scale ERP implementations, Finance transformation, SAP S/4HANA programs, cloud modernization, or enterprise system upgrades. Knowledge of Finance data warehousing, data integration, semantic layers, business intelligence, reporting modernization, or analytics platforms. Experience defining Finance data quality rules, reconciliation needs, validation logic, reporting requirements, and business acceptance criteria. Familiarity with SOX-aware requirements, audit controls, change control, release governance, and data integrity practices. Experience with Enterprise Performance Management tools, including Oracle Essbase or similar budgeting, planning, forecasting, and management reporting platforms. Experience in healthcare, oncology, provider networks, life sciences, or other regulated environments. Strong facilitation, communication, stakeholder management, and executive-facing presentation skills. title: Senior Escrow Product Manager
jd_text: Overview: M&T Bank is seeking a strategic and execution-oriented Escrow & Virtual Account Management (VAM) Product Manager to lead the growth, modernization, and commercialization of our escrow and virtual account solutions. This role is responsible for defining product strategy, delivering new capabilities, managing the product roadmap, and ensuring that M&T's escrow and VAM offerings meet the evolving needs of commercial clients across multiple industry segments. The successful candidate will combine deep product management expertise with strong commercial banking knowledge to deliver differentiated solutions for clients requiring fund segregation, reconciliation, liquidity optimization, and operational efficiency. This position serves as the central point of accountability across Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, Legal, Treasury Management, and Sales teams to successfully design, launch, and enhance escrow and virtual account solutions. Primary Responsibilities: Product Strategy & Market Leadership: Develop and execute the strategic roadmap for Escrow and Virtual Account Management solutions. Identify emerging client needs, industry trends, competitive threats, and fintech opportunities. Define product positioning and value propositions across Commercial Banking, Business Banking, and specialized vertical markets. Establish multi-year product vision aligned with M&T's deposits, liquidity, and treasury management strategies. New Capability Development: Build business cases, secure funding, establish success metrics, and manage prioritization. Partner with Technology and Agile delivery teams to execute product initiatives. Drive capabilities such as: Self-service virtual account administration Virtual account-to-physical account reconciliation Enhanced reporting and analytics Treasury workstation and ERP integrations API connectivity Automated funding and sweeps Real-time payments and liquidity functionality These initiatives align with existing roadmap priorities including reconciliation tools, Treasury Center integration, balance reporting, Direct Connect integration, and enhanced escrow reporting. ​ Market Segmentation & Client Differentiation: Design product strategies tailored to the unique needs of distinct customer segments, including: Commercial Real Estate Property Management Attorney Trust Accounts Municipal Escrow 1031 Exchange Intermediaries Funeral Escrow Providers Leasing & Security Deposit Providers Large Corporate Treasury Organizations Franchise and Multi-Entity Businesses The Product Manager will be responsible for understanding the operational workflows, regulatory requirements, reconciliation challenges, and reporting needs unique to each segment and ensuring solutions are designed accordingly. M&T's escrow offering currently supports multiple specialized escrow structures across these client types. Virtual Account Management Solution Design: Lead the evolution of M&T's Virtual Account Management platform. Responsibilities include: Designing virtual account hierarchies and account structures. Defining cash concentration and fund segregation models. Supporting treasury visibility and liquidity optimization. Developing reporting and reconciliation frameworks. Building client-controlled virtual account administration capabilities. Enhancing integration with Treasury Center, APIs, ERP platforms, and treasury workstations. Supporting real-time information delivery and account governance. Commercialization & Revenue Growth: Partner with Treasury Management, Sales, Segment Management, and Marketing teams to drive product adoption. Develop pricing, packaging, and go-to-market strategies. Create sales enablement materials and client-facing value propositions. Support large prospect opportunities and strategic client engagements. Risk, Compliance & Operational Excellence: Ensure products operate within all regulatory, legal, and risk management requirements. Partner with Legal, Compliance, Operations, and Audit functions. Drive operational efficiency and scalability. Identify process improvement opportunities that enhance both client and employee experiences. Success Measures: The Escrow & VAM Product Manager will be accountable for: Growing escrow and VAM revenue Increasing product adoption and client penetration Delivering new roadmap capabilities on schedule Improving client satisfaction and retention Reducing operational complexity and servicing costs Enhancing competitive differentiation in target markets Improving treasury visibility and reconciliation outcomes for clients Education and Experience Required: Bachelor’s degree 7 years’ proven product management experience in commercial banking, treasury management, liquidity solutions, or payments. OR in lieu of a degree, A combined minimum of 11 years’ higher education and/or work experience, including a minimum of 7 years Proven product management experience in commercial banking, treasury management, liquidity solutions, or payments. Education and Experience Preferred: Experience with: Escrow services Virtual Account Management ZBA and Sweep solutions Treasury Management platforms ERP integrations Commercial deposit products Knowledge of commercial real estate, property management, legal trust, and fund administration workflows Proven experience launching and commercializing new banking or fintech capabilities. Experience managing cross-functional product delivery initiatives. Strong understanding of commercial deposit and liquidity products. Demonstrated ability to create product roadmaps and business cases. Experience working with Technology, Operations, Risk, and Sales organizations. M&T Bank is committed to fair, competitive, and market-informed pay for our employees. The pay range for this position is $107,500.00 - $179,100.00 Annual (USD). The successful candidate’s particular combination of knowledge, skills, and experience will inform their specific compensation. The range listed above corresponds to our national pay range for this role. The specific pay range applicable to you may vary based on your location. Position Summary The Sr. Analyst, Statistical Forecast & Accuracy is an individual contributor within the Demand Planning team, reporting directly to the Consensus Demand Planning Lead. This role is the technical authority for the statistical forecast that underlies the consensus plan. The Sr. Analyst is accountable for ensuring the system produces a reliable, accurate baseline forecast across portfolios, and governing forecast performance over time. This role intervenes when the engine produces outputs that do not reflect reality, manages model parameters and bias across portfolios, and drives the continuous improvement discipline that makes the consensus forecast credible and defensible. This is a technical role that requires deep proficiency in statistical forecasting methods, hands-on expertise in Kinaxis Maestro, and the judgment to distinguish a model problem from a demand reality problem. The Sr. Analyst must be able to translate statistical findings into clear, actionable guidance for the Consensus Demand Planning Lead. Key Responsibilities Statistical Forecasting & Model Governance Own the configuration and maintenance of statistical forecast parameters in Kinaxis Maestro, including model selection and parameter tuning. Apply history cleansing disciplines prior to each forecast cycle, adjusting for outliers, customer losses, NDC switches, and new product launches to ensure the statistical baseline reflects true underlying demand patterns. Intervene directly when the system produces outputs that are wrong: update model parameters, alter model selection, and document the rationale for every change so that interventions are traceable and auditable. Serve as the primary point of contact for the COE on statistical forecast configuration, parameter governance, and planning engine integrity questions. Forecast Accuracy & Bias Management Own the forecast accuracy and bias measurement framework across all portfolios, tracking MAPE, bias, and error metrics at the appropriate level of granularity to surface actionable insights rather than just headline numbers. Conduct structured root cause analysis on forecast misses, distinguishing between model failure, enrichment failure, and genuine demand variability, and communicating findings clearly to the Consensus Demand Planning Lead and Channel Leads. Identify and flag systematic bias in the statistical forecast, whether directional over- or under-forecasting by product type, channel, or time horizon, and drive model adjustments to correct it. Maintain a continuous improvement cadence, tracking accuracy trend over time and holding the team accountable to improving against a defined baseline as the system matures and data quality improves. Partner with Channel Leads to determine whether a forecast miss originated in the statistical baseline or in enrichment inputs, and prepare forecast performance reporting for S&OP reviews facilitated by the COE, ensuring accuracy findings are visible to cross-functional participants and tied to operational implications for supply and inventory. Job Description Position Summary The Sr. Analyst, Demand Planning Channel Lead is an individual contributor within the Demand Planning team, reporting directly to the Director, Consensus Demand Planning. This role serves as the senior demand planning subject matter expert for an assigned channel, leading the development of demand planning methodologies, driving strategic forecast improvements, and influencing cross-functional decision making that impacts inventory, service, and financial outcomes across the enterprise. This role serves as the subject matter expert on their channel's demand dynamics, translating external signals, and near-term order patterns into forecast inputs that improve the accuracy and reliability of the consensus plan. This role requires both analytical depth and strong cross-functional partnership skills; this individual must be comfortable working inside Kinaxis Maestro and engaging with cross functional stakeholders to build the alignment that a credible consensus forecast requires. Key Responsibilities Market Intelligence & Enrichment Own the process of identifying, evaluating, and incorporating external demand-side signals for the assigned channel into the statistical baseline forecast, including macroeconomic trends, payer policy changes, healthcare system dynamics, and geopolitical disruptions that could materially affect product demand. Monitor the external environment on an ongoing basis for the assigned channel, proactively surfacing signals that warrant a forecast adjustment rather than waiting for downstream teams to flag the impact. Ensure all enrichments are documented and traceable so that forecast decisions can be explained, audited, and used to improve future enrichment quality over time. Lead the development and continuous improvement of demand enrichment methodologies, standards, and governance practices across demand planning. Evaluate emerging market trends and industry developments, translating insights into forecasting strategies and planning assumptions. Provide guidance and consultation to planners and business partners regarding the interpretation and application of external demand signals. Long Range Consensus Forecasting Own the channel-level demand inputs into the long-range consensus forecast, aligning signals from cross functional partners into a single agreed-upon view in Kinaxis Maestro for the assigned channel. Extend the planning horizon beyond near-term views for the assigned channel, ensuring that forward-looking demand assumptions are reflected in the consensus plan and available to support supply and inventory decisions across a meaningful planning window. Maintain active relationships with cross functional partners for the assigned channel, ensuring that demand-relevant intelligence is flowing into the planning process on a timely and structured basis rather than arriving ad-hoc. Facilitate resolution of complex cross-functional demand planning issues where business priorities, supply constraints, and forecast assumptions require executive-level alignment. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance forecast accuracy, forecast efficiency, and planning capabilities across the broader organization. Represent Demand Planning in strategic planning discussions and provide recommendations that influence long-term inventory and capacity decisions. Prepare channel-level demand assumptions packages that are ready for presentation in S&OP reviews facilitated by the COE, ensuring the framing is clear and the key assumptions are visible to cross-functional participants. Demand Sensing Monitor short-term order patterns, shipment data, and near-real-time demand signals for the assigned channel to identify deviations from the statistical baseline that require immediate forecast adjustment. Refine near-term forecasts on a rolling basis using demand sensing inputs, reducing the lag between market reality and the plan without waiting for the next monthly consensus cycle. Apply clear thresholds for when a demand sensing signal for the assigned channel is material enough to trigger an off-cycle forecast update versus being held for the next scheduled planning cycle. Ensure near-term demand sensing outputs for the assigned channel are visible and actionable in the weekly S&OE cycle, flagging operationally significant deviations before they create inventory or service risk. This role reports to the Director of Customer Facing Demand Planning. They execute the customer-specific demand remit for the assigned accounts, managing inventory positioning, and service levels at the account level, while capturing and qualifying inbound demand signals including new product launches, and translating that customer intelligence back into the consensus planning process. Key Responsibilities Customer Demand Execution Maintain the customer portfolio for assigned accounts, managing formulary changes, product switches, and customer-specific inventory positions to ensure the customer-product data feeding into demand planning accurately reflects current program commitments and account relationships. Own sequestration for assigned accounts, creating and maintaining inventory buckets, assigning the correct customer accounts to each program, and coordinating with DC inventory teams to move product and discontinue sequestered item numbers as needed. Execute customer-specific award switch management for assigned accounts, updating the demand signal, adjusting the forecast for outgoing items, loading anticipated demand for incoming items, and coordinating with key stakeholders to confirm timing before transitions go live. Manage new customer onboarding for assigned accounts, including tracking, analysis, inventory builds, allocation planning, coverage reporting, SL queries, and omit analysis to ensure readiness for go-live. Manage customer-facing calls and relationships within the context of customer demand for assigned accounts, handling ad-hoc inquiries, SL questions, and contractual requirement tracking to ensure compliance and customer satisfaction. Demand Signal Intake & Translation Capture and qualify demand intelligence from assigned accounts, translating customer-specific signals including new product launches, promotional activity, program changes, and account-level shifts into structured forecast inputs, operational rules, and purchasing inputs that are consumable by the consensus demand planning team. Monitor and manage upstream demand inputs for assigned accounts, including program changes, new launch items, promotional activity, and customer-specific shifts, ensuring they are captured proactively and reflected in the plan before they create a supply risk. Own the handoff of enriched demand signal inputs from assigned accounts to the consensus demand planning team, ensuring inputs are complete, documented, and delivered on time within the monthly planning cycle. Maintain an active working relationship with the consensus demand planning team, ensuring demand signal inputs for assigned accounts are understood, accepted, and incorporated into the consensus forecast without delays or misalignment.
